proposal.reason: Analyze evidence shows a material row-estimate error: estimated 106720 rows versus 1 actual. The stored single-column sample frequency for the lookup value is 1, meaning the sampled distribution attributes almost all rows to this value, while only 1 row actually matches. On the scan, 100000 rows were examined to return 1 row, consistent with the plan trusting stale statistics. A covering index exists, but the stale statistics are the likely cause of the seq scan choice, so a targeted ANALYZE refresh is the smallest justified change. Uncertainty: the error alone does not prove staleness; the sampled fraction of 1 with a single actual match is the main supporting evidence. Statistics-detail MCV changes were not chosen because no multi-column predicate evidence was supplied.
